en.io: Input: a prescribed prompt, deployment details, and documentation research. Output: an expected .claude/skills/agent-integration/SKILL.md containing integration patterns and templates.
en.boundary: This is a lesson and example set, not an implemented integration. The supplied code is illustrative and includes broad exception fallback. Producing a verified skill depends on external documentation and tools not attached to the evidence.
dependencies: Official OpenAI SDK, LiteLLM, and FastMCP documentation
Optional Ollama or another model backend
scenarios: Create a reference skill from official SDK documentation.
Configure an OpenAI-compatible client through LiteLLM.
Study structured tool schemas and model fallback patterns.
Map local Ollama deployments to agent frameworks.
